text: Nobody moved more overnight than AOC, who lost 0.9 points and now trades at 16.9. Both books agreed on the direction, with Kalshi moving 1.0 point and Polymarket 0.8 points. The odds that Abdul El-Sayed enters the race fell 14 points on Kalshi, to 11 percent, even though El-Sayed's nomination price barely moved. In the simulations AOC went from 33 to 32 percent of first-place finishes. The markets have Jon Ossoff on top at 22. In our simulations it's AOC, first in 32 percent of runs. In 11 percent of those runs nobody reaches the convention with a pledged majority. Tonight's prices will show whether the AOC move holds.
